strings.Per proteggere di più: una frase tua e l: To protect more: your own long phrase (at least four words) and the ASEM_ENC_KEY constant in wp-config.php.
strings.Riapri la chiave con la frase: Reopen the key with the phrase
strings.Scegli una frase e conservala fuori dal: Choose a phrase and keep it outside the site (on paper or in a password manager): it is needed to reopen the documents if the site is moved or repaired.
strings.La chiave principale dei file riservati: The main key of the private files is derived from them, so it is weaker: whoever also had the database could open the files. It is better to add the ASEM_ENC_KEY constant to wp-config.php, with a long random text.
strings.Il PDF della ricevuta n. {n} non è leggi: The PDF of receipt no. {n} cannot be read on this site: {motivo}
strings.File cifrati che la chiave non apre: Encrypted files the key does not open
strings.file cifrato che la chiave di questo sit: encrypted file that this site's key does not open
strings.I PDF si salvano cifrati: per controllar: PDFs are saved encrypted: to check them the site opens them and compares the fingerprint of the content with the one written at issue.
strings.Nella copia i PDF restano cifrati, come: In the backup the PDFs stay encrypted, as on the site.
strings.Scrivi la frase: se non l'hai cambiata,: Type the phrase: if you did not change it, it is the license code (or, in the free plugin, the activation date and time) you had when you made the backup. It must be typed exactly as it was, spaces and hyphens included.
strings.Se queste parole non ti dicono nulla, ch: If these words mean nothing to you, ask whoever manages the site.
strings.Rifare questo PDF dai dati salvati all'e: Redo this PDF from the data saved at issue? The new file is saved encrypted; a different file is set aside and the operation is written to the action log.
strings.I PDF dello ZIP non sono cifrati e conte: The PDFs in the ZIP are not encrypted and contain personal data (name, tax code, amounts): keep it carefully and delete it when you no longer need it.
strings.La frase è la data e l'ora di attivazion: The phrase is the activation date and time of the plugin: {timestamp}. It must be typed exactly as you see it here, spaces and hyphens included. Keep it (it can be printed).
strings.Va scritta esattamente come la vedi qui,: It must be typed exactly as you see it here, spaces and hyphens included.
strings.Il PDF di questa ricevuta è cifrato e la: The PDF of this receipt is encrypted and this site's key does not open it: it is not redone, so as not to lose the file. First fix the key from Settings → Backup → «Encryption of private files».
strings.Certificati medici, documenti e scansion: Medical certificates, documents and scans, transaction attachments, reimbursement receipts, inventory photos and receipt PDFs are saved encrypted on disk: whoever took away only the files folder, without the database, could not read them. The plugin manages the key by itself.
strings.Alcuni PDF sono cifrati e la chiave di q: Some PDFs are encrypted and this site's key does not open them: the files were not touched. Fix the key from Settings → Backup → «Encryption of private files»; until it is fixed, downloading those receipts gives an error.
strings.Queste ricevute non hanno i dati salvati: These receipts have no saved data: their PDF has not been fixed yet and is not in the backup. Opening or downloading the receipt once saves its data of that moment and fixes its PDF; receipts already voided in this state can no longer be opened.
strings.Lo stato si vede in Impostazioni → Copia: The status is shown in Settings → Backup → «Encryption of private files».
strings.Si fa da sola, mentre usi il programma:: It runs by itself, while you use the program: there is nothing to press.
strings.La cifratura dei certificati medici è pa: Encryption of the medical certificates has started.
strings.Il lavoro prosegue da solo, un lotto al: The work continues by itself, one batch per minute.
strings.Cifratura dei certificati medici in cors: Encryption of the medical certificates in progress: {n} left.
strings.La cifratura dei certificati medici è fi: Encryption of the medical certificates is finished, but {f} could not be encrypted and {m} were not found on disk.
strings.I certificati non cifrati sono rimasti d: The certificates that were not encrypted were left where they were, in plain form: the list is in Settings → Backup → «Encryption of private files». Open the list and press «Retry»; if the file cannot be found, delete the certificate from the Certificates page and upload it again, or restore a backup.
strings.La cifratura dei certificati medici è fi: Encryption of the medical certificates is finished.
strings.Tutti i certificati già caricati sono or: All the certificates already uploaded are now encrypted on disk.
strings.I certificati medici già caricati restan: The medical certificates already uploaded stay in plain form: this server lacks the encryption library (sodium).
strings.La cifratura parte da sola appena l'este: Encryption starts by itself as soon as the PHP sodium extension is enabled. Ask whoever manages the server or the hosting.
strings.La cifratura dei certificati medici è fe: Encryption of the medical certificates is stopped: the key does not open on this site.
strings.I certificati già caricati restano in ch: The certificates already uploaded stay in plain form and nothing is touched. The key must be fixed (Settings → Backup → «Encryption of private files» → «Fixing the key»): then encryption restarts by itself.
strings.Buongiorno, sul nostro sito serve attiva: Hello, on our site the PHP sodium extension needs to be enabled (encryption of private documents and medical certificates). Thank you.
strings.Se non l'hai cambiata, la frase è la dat: If you have not changed it, the phrase is the activation date and time: {when}. It must be typed exactly like this, spaces and hyphens included.
